recipes.network_enforcement: Every Lean invocation runs under bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host root, and only a fresh temporary module directory writable. Python, Lake, and Git orchestration runs on the host and is checked to perform local inspection only; host-wide network denial for orchestration is not claimed.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six UTF-8 summary lines bound by validation-receipt.json

recipes.scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero Lean replay from copied sources against the existing compiled package roots required by THM-M-0498. Orchestration uses local host tools without a recipe-wide network namespace and the final replay makes no fetch request. The shared cache is contaminated by the separately disclosed accidental flt-regular reconciliation and is nonrelease. Covered obligation IDs are corroborated surfaces, not accepted closure: the Dirichlet node still has a planned fingerprint, both root compositions require the unproved analytic package, and complete provenance/TCB, cold hermetic, and distinct-runner independent gates remain fail-closed.
